question: Who among the following was the First Vice Chancellor of Maulana Azad National Urdu University?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prof. Mohammed Shamim Jairajpuri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Prof. Mohammed Shamim Jairajpuri was the first Vice Chancellor of Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU).
 
• He served as the founding Vice Chancellor from 1998 to 2003.
 
• MANUU was established in 1998 in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
 
• Prof. Jairajpuri is known for his contributions to the field of zoology and academia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU)**

 
 
• It is a Central University established by an Act of the Parliament in 1998.
 
• Named after Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, the scholar and senior leader of the Indian independence movement.
 
• The university aims to promote and develop the Urdu language and provide vocational and technical education in Urdu medium.
 
• It offers various undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs across disciplines.
 
 
 
• **Prof. Mohammed Shamim Jairajpuri**
 
 
• He is a renowned zoologist specializing in nematology.
 
• Authored several books and research papers in the field of zoology.
 
• Recipient of various awards and honors for his contributions to science and education.
 
 
 
• **Vice Chancellor's Role**
 
 
• The Vice Chancellor is the chief executive officer of a university.
 
• Responsible for the academic, administrative, and financial management of the institution.
 
• Plays a crucial role in policy formulation and implementation to achieve the university's goals.
